scene: Exact WL101C/D SSS cfg0 on ecro_lr3_adapter
field: B_star is the conditional mean RGB outgoing radiance of physical E2–E5, with uniform area and uniform solid angle on the physically exposed preimage of each unchanged patch/bin lookup. First hit is pinned to the requested native shape, at the requested surface point. The remainder uses the unmodified pt100 trace on the complete original scene.
support: Physical front wi.z > 1e-6. Floor under the coplanar Box B footprint and its opposing underside lack an open free-space side and have zero exposed support there. Sphere/floor tangency itself has zero area; surrounding positive-gap points remain eligible. Numerical patch/bin boundary ties are counted separately. No rerouting, denominator-only backfaces, fallback values or learned inputs.
bin_zero: The camera quantizer clamps negative patch-frame z to ring zero. For the curved sphere use z in [-1,0.25) at ring zero and condition on the actual surface front. Other bins use the original quarter-width z intervals. Planar patches use the original nonnegative hemisphere.
normalization: Each eligible sample contributes both RGB radiance and one count to its own verified address. Divide by accepted count, without cosine, area, solid angle or source scaling. Zero-count slots remain explicitly flagged and may participate in the camera experiment only if their unit marker is identically absent on every evaluation stream.
reference: Original WL101A matched physical six-event halves. Reuse corresponding archived WL101A learned readouts only after verifying hashes and exact B_theta. Oracle field seeds are independent.

gates.shape_point_and_address: No non-tie native attachment or address mismatch. Numerical rounding ties must be within declared 8e-6 address coordinates of a boundary, at most 0.005% of eligible proposals, and reported. Native point attachment distance <= 4e-6 m.
gates.physical_support: Analytic coplanar predicate audited against independent convex polygon areas for every floor patch. No camera weight on empty slots. Membership acceptance is independent of sampled radiance.
gates.suffix: Probe E2 and E3–E5 equal the five-event camera-mode suffix from the same pinned surface, ray and RNG to 1e-6 absolute. Independent original unpinned camera-mode suffix on unambiguously exposed control rays also agrees within 1e-3 relative L1.
gates.low_and_readout: Original address-coded table test, zero and linearity. Matched LOW relative L1 versus archived learned <=1e-7 and physical <=1e-4.
gates.precision: Approximate conservative 95% crossed intervals combine four independent table means and two paired camera/reference streams in quadrature with Welch degrees of freedom. Half widths for both contributions must be <=25% of historical WL101C bias/contrast magnitude respectively. Stop on failure.
gates.attribution: T=learned minus physical; G=learned minus Oracle (generated-table-side); R=Oracle minus physical (representation/readout-side). Signed decomposition and fractions. If T reliably positive at both endpoints and only G is resolved positive at both, generated-table-side; only R positive at both, representation/readout-side; both resolved at either endpoint or different resolved owners by endpoint, mixed; otherwise inconclusive. Opposite sign indicates compensation.

masked_data: Original WL101C ROIs and profiles. Preserve per-slot proposal and accepted counts, per-slot unbiased RGB sample variances and all independent Oracle tables and two grouped halves. Save all eight matched readings with LOW, HIGH and full, plus the original B_theta.
display: Original WL101C exposure and signed HDR luminance cap. No evaluation clipping.
